# StatusTag

A filled label for the condition something is in, such as "Needs review" or "Overdue". It is never a button; its appearance carries the meaning.

Also asked as: lozenge, pill, state label.

**Import:** `import { StatusTag } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/labels/StatusTag/StatusTag.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/labels/StatusTag/StatusTag.stories.jsx` — Styles, WithCount, TrailingMetricAppearance, LeadingVisual, Truncation, NarrowContainer, NeverAButton, PinnedWeight, UnknownValuesFallBack, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, Disabled

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/labels/StatusTag/StatusTag.mdx`

## Usage

Use `StatusTag` for the condition something is in when that condition can change:
completed, needs review, missed, in progress. It is the same component whether
the system calculated the state or a person set it.

- **Is it a number?** Count tag.
- **Is it a due or event date?** Date tag.
- **Is it the condition something is in, and can that condition change?** Status tag.
- **Otherwise** (a subject, a person, a category): Tag.

Use `spacing="default"` (20) in rows, lists, tables and sentences, and
`spacing="spacious"` (32) beside a heading.

### Appearance guidance

| Appearance | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Neutral | Not started. |
| Success | Done. Example: "Completed". |
| Warning | Needs attention. Example: "Needs review". |
| Danger | Failed or missed. Example: "Missed". |
| Info | In progress. Example: "In progress". |
| Discovery | New. |

## Best practices

### Match the appearance to the meaning. {#match-the-appearance-to-the-meaning}

Color carries the verdict, so success never labels a problem. Each appearance
means one thing (see the guidance above). There is no color prop; a category
with a color is a Tag.

Do: Success for a finished thing.
Don't: Danger on a finished thing.

### Keep labels to one or two words. {#keep-labels-to-one-or-two-words}

A status is read at a glance; a sentence belongs in the row text.

Do: On track.
Don't: A sentence in the tag.

### Show one status per object. {#show-one-status-per-object}

Two statuses on one object force people to decide which is true.

Do: One status per row.
Don't: Two competing statuses.

### Nest a count instead of placing one beside it. {#nest-a-count-instead-of-placing-one-beside-it}

Do: One label; the number reads as part of it.
Don't: Two labels that read as unrelated.

### Give the metric its own appearance when it means something else. {#give-the-metric-its-own-appearance-when-it-means-something-else}

`trailingMetricAppearance` defaults to the Status tag's own appearance. Set it
only when the number carries a different meaning from the status, such as a
success status with a danger count of failures.

### Edit in the field, not on the label. {#edit-in-the-field-not-on-the-label}

A Status tag never opens a menu. Where a status can be changed, the field around
it becomes an inline Dropdown whose options are grouped To do · In progress ·
Complete · Exception · Failed, each group with one appearance (neutral · info ·
success · warning · danger).

## Accessibility

- **Read as its text.** A Status tag is a `span` with no role, so a screen reader
  announces its text and nothing suggests it can be pressed. An `onClick` is
  dropped with a development warning.
- **Not a tab stop, unless truncated.** When the label is clipped, the Status tag
  takes focus so a keyboard user can reach the tooltip holding the full text;
  pointer users get the same tooltip on hover. The full text is always in the
  DOM, so a screen reader hears all of it.
- **Not color alone.** A state can add a `leadingVisual` where color alone is
  not enough. Icons are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
- **An edge on any surface.** The 1px inside border keeps a pale fill visible
  on white and on gray; in forced-colors mode it becomes a real border.

## Related

- For a number on its own, use `CountTag`; Status tag nests one through `trailingMetric`.
- For a due or event date, use `DateTag`.
- For a category, a subject or a person, use `Tag` (or `SmartTag` for a SMART subject).

Same group: `AiLabel` · `AiMessage` · `CountTag` · `DateTag` · `PromptStarters` · `SmartTag` · `Suggestion` · `Tag` · `TagGroup`

## Parts

1. **Leading visual.** Optional: a Font Awesome Free icon by name, or a node.
2. **Label.** The condition, in a word or two. Past `maxWidth` it ends in an ellipsis and the full text is a tooltip.
3. **Trailing metric.** Optional: a compact Count tag nested inside, with its own appearance when it means something else.
4. **Fill.** The appearance's tinted ground with its words and an edge one step darker.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The only state. A status that can change is edited in the field around it. |
| Hovered, pressed | None. It is a label, not a control; the thing around it is what responds. |
| Focused | None. It is not in the tab order. A truncated label takes focus only so a keyboard user can reach the tooltip with its full text. |
| Disabled | None. A label is never dimmed; a disabled thing is described by the control beside it. |

| Part | Token |

| Padding and gap | `--pad-x-xs` on the leading edge, 2 on the trailing edge and between icon and label, `--stack-sm` inside the text; spacious `--pad-x-md` with 6 behind. |
| Corner | `--radius-md`; spacious 6. |

| Info and discovery | `--ds-background-information` and `--ds-background-smart-mastering-content`, with their text and pressed steps. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the condition: "In review", "Overdue", "Approved". | Write an action: "Review now". A status is not a button. |
| Use one or two words, in sentence case. | Write a sentence or end with a period. |
| Keep one wording for one condition across the product. | Use "Done" here and "Complete" there for the same state. |
| Let a trailing metric be a plain number. | Put words in the metric. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | node (required) | — | The status text, as people say it: "Needs review", "Due tomorrow". |
| `appearance` | enum | `'neutral'` | The meaning. Info is Tertiary; discovery is the curriculum purple. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` (20) in rows, lists and sentences; `spacious` (32) beside a heading. |
| `leadingVisual` | string or node | — | One icon before the label: a Font Awesome Free name (`circle-check`) or a node. |
| `trailingMetric` | number or string | — | A small count at the end of the tag, a Count tag nested inside it: compact (16) in default, default (20) in spacious. Hidden at 0. |
| `trailingMetricAppearance` | oneOf | — | The Count tag's appearance. Defaults to the Status tag's own. |
| `maxWidth` | number or string | `200` | The widest the Status tag grows, in px or any CSS length, and never wider than its container. Past it the label ends in an ellipsis and the full text is a tooltip. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the tag element beside the component's own. |
| `id` | string | — | The `id` attribute of the tag element. |
